title: How a Godly Man Stays Steady While Everyone Around Him Gets Engaged
caption:
Another wedding invite. Another timeline that isn't yours.

God's not slow on your wedding invite. He's finishing a man first.

The ache to be known is honest. Let it drive you to Him, not to comparing your life against everyone else's feed.

Build the man you'd actually bring to a wife. The rest is His to run.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #singleness #chasegod
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
